update_checkpoint_mmf_to_lightning: convert an MMF checkpoint to PyTorch Lightning format using MMFToPLCheckpointUpdater
check_is_pl_model_checkpoint: check if a checkpoint dict contains a state_dict key for PyTorch Lightning model checkpoints
check_is_pl_trainer_checkpoint: check if a checkpoint dict contains a pytorch-lightning_version key for trainer checkpoints
check_is_model_only_checkpoint: check if a checkpoint contains only model weights without trainer state
get_pretrained_state_mapping: get a mapping of checkpoint keys to model state keys using pretrained_state_mapping config
